## Problem statement

What are you trying to understand about a session, and why is the current behavior insufficient?

## Proposed behavior

What should the app, plugin or export do instead? Concrete UI text, metric definition or output shape helps.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches, existing workarounds, or why the current behavior might be deliberate.

## Impact

Who benefits (solo users, teams, plugin authors), how often the case occurs, and whether it affects read-only guarantees or metrics correctness.
